target: Three services A, B, and C share a cache. Measured savings for coalitions are v(empty)=0; each singleton saves 0; v(AB)=6, v(AC)=4, v(BC)=2, and v(ABC)=12. The team must allocate the 12 units of joint savings using the symmetric marginal-contribution average over all service arrival orders, rather than split equally.
surface: A previous cloud cost review split the 12 units equally, assigning 4 to each service without using any coalition's marginal savings.
structural: A cooperative voting game used the Shapley value. For each player it averaged that player's marginal contribution v(S union {i})-v(S) over every permutation of player arrival order (equivalently weighted every predecessor coalition by |S|!(n-|S|-1)!/n!). The allocations summed to v(all)-v(empty).
rubric: Explicitly selects the Shapley marginal-contribution value.
Averages marginal contributions over all six arrival permutations or uses the equivalent weighted coalition formula.
Checks efficiency 5+4+3=12 and recommends that allocation rather than 4,4,4.
